{{Short description|Football competition in South America}}
The '''2021 Copa Sudamericana group stage''' was played from 20 April to 27 May 2021.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2021_02_10_2020.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2021: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide eight of the 16 places in the [[2021 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]] of the [[2021 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento-sudamericana-manual-de-clubes-2021-es.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the group stage was held on 9 April 2021, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="Group stage draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/pautas-del-sorteo-de-la-fase-de-grupos-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2021|title=Pautas del sorteo de la Fase de Grupos de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=5 April 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/32-equipos-arrancan-su-andar-con-miras-la-gran-conquista|title=32 equipos arrancan su andar con miras a La Gran Conquista|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=5 April 2021}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 1 February 2021 (shown in parentheses),<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/se-lanza-el-ranking-de-clubes-conmebol-2021|title=Se lanza el Ranking de Clubes CONMEBOL 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=2 February 2021|language=es}}</ref><ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/conmebol_-_rankings_2021_-_1_febrero_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2011–2020.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2010 and 2002–2010 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.

For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group, excluding the four losers of the Copa Libertadores third stage, which were seeded in Pot 4 and whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, and could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the group stage, each group is played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The teams are ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Away goals scored; 5. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 2.4.3).<ref name="regulations"/>

The winners of each group advanced to the [[2021 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2021 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]].<section end=Format />
